mapper.select: SELECT SNAPSHOT_SEQ, TAKEN_AT, REASON, LABEL, TAKEN_USER, BODY_SIZE FROM wo_workbook_snapshot WHERE WORKBOOK_SEQ = #{workbookSeq} ORDER BY TAKEN_AT DESC, SNAPSHOT_SEQ DESC
SELECT SNAPSHOT_SEQ, WORKBOOK_SEQ, TAKEN_AT, TAKEN_USER, REASON, LABEL, DOC_TYPE, BODY_SIZE, BODY FROM wo_workbook_snapshot WHERE SNAPSHOT_SEQ = #{snapshotSeq}

SELECT X.WORKBOOK_SEQ FROM ( SELECT E.WORKBOOK_SEQ AS WORKBOOK_SEQ, MAX(E.LAST_AT) AS LAST_AT FROM ( SELECT S.WORKBOOK_SEQ AS WORKBOOK_SEQ, MAX(L.INPUT_DATETIME) AS LAST_AT FROM wo_cell_change_log L JOIN wo_workbook_sheet_line S ON S.SHEET_SEQ = L.SHEET_SEQ GROUP BY S.WORKBOOK_SEQ UNION ALL SELECT D.WORKBOOK_SEQ AS WORKBOOK_SEQ, MAX(D.INPUT_DATETIME) AS LAST_AT FROM wo_doc_change_log D GROUP BY D.WORKBOOK_SEQ ) E JOIN wo_workbook_master W ON W.WORKBOOK_SEQ = E.WORKBOOK_SEQ WHERE W.DEL_DATETIME IS NULL GROUP BY E.WORKBOOK_SEQ ) X WHERE X.LAST_AT <= #{idleUntil} AND X.LAST_AT > #{since} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM wo_workbook_snapshot P WHERE P.WORKBOOK_SEQ = X.WORKBOOK_SEQ AND P.TAKEN_AT >= X.LAST_AT)
